name: cluster_running_pods_drop_anomaly
title: Running pod count dropped
description: Number of pods in phase Running (kube-state-metrics kube_pod_status_phase) is below its learned weekday/weekend hour-of-day band in at least 2 of the last 3 five-minute buckets, a sign of mass eviction or node loss. Unit: pods. On a steady count the band is about 5% of the count per sigma, so only a drop of roughly 15-30% or more fires; losing a few pods does not, and the static pod alerts cover that. Whole cluster; add a condition on namespace or k8s_cluster inside the subquery after install for a per-entity alert (one config per entity). Uses a histogram inside a subquery; keep only after a live _search returns one row per bucket.

anomaly_config.custom_sql: SELECT time_bucket, SUM(v) AS running_pods FROM (SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '5m') AS time_bucket, __hash__, AVG(value) AS v FROM "kube_pod_status_phase" WHERE phase = 'Running' GROUP BY time_bucket, __hash__) GROUP BY time_bucket ORDER BY time_bucket
